description: Vegamælingar á GSM, UMTS (3G), LTE (4G) og TETRA is a dataset listed in Icelandic geoportal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by drive.google.com. Fjarskiptastofa hefur framkvæmt mælingar á fjarskiptasambandi á helstu vegum í vegakerfinu á Íslandi. Mælingar voru gerðar á GSM, UMTS (3G), LTE (4G) og TETRA á vegum Símans, Nova, Vodafone og Neyðarlínunnar. Verkefnið var unnið að ósk Fjarskiptasjóðs og fór þannig fram að starfsmenn Fjarskiptastofu óku eftir þeim vegum sem mældir voru með tilheyrandi mælitæki. Coverage: IS. Its keywords include GSM, GSL, Fjarskipti, Farnet. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2016-10-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-is.
